analyst.summary: Schaeffler India delivered another strong quarter (Q1 CY2026 revenue +18.8% YoY to Rs 2,507cr, EBITDA margin steady at 19.3%, exports +32.5% YoY) continuing a clean multi-year compounding trend independently corroborated in our own PIT data, with a near-debt-free balance sheet, ROCE of 25.5-27.9%, and no governance or balance-sheet red flags. But at ~52-57x trailing earnings and ~10.6x book -- the richest or joint-richest multiple in its own direct bearings/auto-components peer set (Timken India ~55x, SKF India ~31x) -- against consensus forward revenue growth of only ~12% p.a. and a stock that has been flat over the trailing 12 months, the valuation leaves little margin of safety. Capex moderation in 2025 and rising localization-driven competitive intensity in industrial bearings are real, if not yet thesis-breaking, watch items. Call: Hold, not Sell -- the quality and growth are genuine, but this is priced for continued perfection rather than offering upside from here.
